semantic_preflight.economic_sequence: prior strong or leader stock -> impulsive or clearly dominant run-up -> peak -> collapse or liquidation -> economically meaningful downward discontinuity primitives during the main peak-to-trough collapse leg -> unresolved overhead collapse gap zone -> materially lower independent trading regime -> post-collapse low and settling phase -> later approach from below -> first return to the lowest meaningful unresolved collapse-defining layer
semantic_preflight.causal_background: prior speculative or leadership demand followed by liquidation severe enough to create one or more economically important no-trade discontinuities that remain as overhead structure while price establishes a separate lower regime
state_variables: strict-gap primitive width and collapse contribution
semantic_preflight.event_formation_time: the final meaningful collapse-defining primitive in a provisionally grouped stack, after the collapse episode and its peak-to-trough interval have first been identified independently of gaps
semantic_preflight.confirmation_trigger: first later upward trade reaching the lower boundary of the lowest meaningful unresolved collapse-defining layer, conditional on all persistence, lower-regime, post-trough settling, and zero-prior-partial-entry requirements
semantic_preflight.entry_time: NOT_DEFINED; the marker is a human semantic-review anchor only
possible_semantic_ambiguities: whether a 250-session rolling peak is the visually dominant peak
whether 90 percent peak recovery should terminate the collapse episode
whether three closes adequately represent durable recovery between layers
whether width versus collapse contribution best captures economic gap significance
whether multiple meaningful primitives belong to one visual zone
whether the lowest meaningful layer is always the human-selected layer
whether ten sessions adequately captures 留下
whether five fully-below sessions establish an independent regime
whether a rolling-median separation is visually sufficient
whether five post-trough sessions constitute a base
whether an opening jump into the boundary should count as upward return
whether ST and normal stocks share the same visual semantics

chosen_time_anchors.collapse_episode_start: objective prior 250-session peak carried by the daily causal state; the episode is admitted only after a later 30 percent drawdown exists
chosen_time_anchors.collapse_episode_end: earlier of 250 sessions after peak or the first durable recovery defined by three consecutive completed closes at or above 90 percent of peak after the first 30 percent breach
chosen_time_anchors.postcollapse_trough: lowest comparable-coordinate low between the first 30 percent breach and collapse-episode end
chosen_time_anchors.primitive_eligibility_clock: strict primitive date must be strictly after peak and no later than the postcollapse trough
chosen_time_anchors.zone_formation: date of the final meaningful primitive in the frozen stack
chosen_time_anchors.persistence_clock: formation session excluded; at least ten completed intervening sessions before return
chosen_time_anchors.below_zone_clock: at least five consecutive completed sessions with high below the lowest meaningful lower boundary
chosen_time_anchors.base_clock: at least five completed sessions strictly after postcollapse trough and before first return
chosen_time_anchors.first_return: earliest post-formation session with an intraday upward crossing from an open below the lower boundary; any earlier lower-boundary touch is a prior partial entry and rejects the candidate
chosen_time_anchors.blind_chart_end: exact completed one-minute first-return bar, with no later minute or session
